description: Internal to the show_snapshot viewer: renders a sharper close-up of the part of a snapshot the user zoomed into. Not for assistants: use `snapshot` with `region` for a close-up.

documentName.description: The document's name, checked with the id.

maxLongEdgePx.description: Long edge of the close-up in pixels.

snapshotKey.description: The key of the snapshot being zoomed into.
